newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat leaves for home after talks in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Arafat leaves for home after talks in Egypt.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat left on Friday after a one-day visit to discuss with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak the latest crisis in Middle East peace talks, airport sources said.

Arafat and Mubarak discussed for almost three hours on Thursday Israel's decision to start building a new settlement in Arab East Jerusalem. Egypt has warned Israel that the settlement could jeopardise the peace process.
